beta.assumptions: News minimum 4h; events/materials minimum 24h; all eligible configured+restored sources assumed due. Upper model, not measured full operation. HTTP cache/conditional requests retain request counts but reduce bytes. One request per descriptor is only the base; pagination/detail/SEC/retry requests and runtime are not measured or included.
